name: Orange Crush | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Ready-To-Use)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. 
Get ready for a sweet and tangy twist with Orange Crush. The perfect sativa for those sunny vibes, with a refreshing, uplifting experience wherever you go. 
Orange 
Citrus 
Tangy
